Matcha latte and ice cream is my life

The Crescent Mall branch has such a lovely view; going there at noon with friends feels like a little escape to another city.

Morico Café and Dining: Cozy Ambiance and Delicious Food for Every Occasion
Jan 2025 • Friends
Morico Café and Dining is one of my favorite spots for lunch and meeting friends. The cozy yet stylish atmosphere makes it an ideal place to relax and catch up with loved ones. The menu has a great variety, offering everything from light bites to more substantial meals, all made with fresh ingredients. The coffee is consistently good, and the desserts are a real treat. The service is always friendly and attentive, making every visit enjoyable. Whether it’s a casual lunch or a special gathering, Morico never disappoints with its quality food and inviting ambiance.
(I love matcha and Japanese food)
